raw_translation: Norwayspris hutumia bei ya kumbukumbu iliyowekwa ya NOK ZXQPH0003QXZ/kWh ikiwa ni pamoja na VAT (NOK ZXQPH0004QXZ bila VAT ya umeme); malipo yake hutumia bei ya mwezi mzima ya eneo-wastani na matumizi yanayoweza kupimwa. kifuniko ni ZXQPH0005QXZ kWh/mwezi kwa nyumba au ZXQPH0006QXZ kWh/mwezi kwa nyumba ya likizo. kaya inaweza kuchagua mpango mmoja, si wote wawili. malipo ya mtandao na ada nyingine huingizwa tofauti na kuongezwa kwa matukio yote. kulinganisha hutumia data halisi ya kila saa unayotoa; haitoi bei.
source: The standard household support pays 90% of each hourly spot-price amount above NOK 0.77/kWh before VAT, for eligible use up to 5,000 kWh per month. Norgespris uses a fixed reference price of NOK 0.50/kWh including VAT (NOK 0.40 without electricity VAT); its settlement uses the full month’s area-average spot price and eligible metered use. The cap is 5,000 kWh/month for a home or 1,000 kWh/month for a holiday home. A household can choose one scheme, not both. Network charges and other fees are entered separately and added to all scenarios. The comparison uses the exact hourly data you provide; it does not fetch prices.
translation: Norwayspris hutumia bei ya kumbukumbu iliyowekwa ya NOK ZXQPH0003QXZ/kWh ikiwa ni pamoja na VAT (NOK ZXQPH0004QXZ bila VAT ya umeme); malipo yake hutumia bei ya mwezi mzima ya eneo-wastani na matumizi yanayoweza kupimwa. kifuniko ni ZXQPH0005QXZ kWh/mwezi kwa nyumba au ZXQPH0006QXZ kWh/mwezi kwa nyumba ya likizo. kaya inaweza kuchagua mpango mmoja, si wote wawili. malipo ya mtandao na ada nyingine huingizwa tofauti na kuongezwa kwa matukio yote. kulinganisha hutumia data halisi ya kila saa unayotoa; haitoi bei.
